acceptance: tpcds and tpcds_obt below 0.01 raise ScaleFactorOutOfRangeError, shown by a test that fails before the change.
The message states what was observed and makes no wider claim.
description:
## Problem
After #4335 and #4401, `validate_scale_factor` in benchbox/core/benchmark_registry.py calls `validate_tpcds_scale` first for a tpcds or tpcds_obt scale between 0 and the 0.01 floor, so the caller gets a plain `ValueError` instead of `ScaleFactorOutOfRangeError`. The message in benchbox/core/tpcds/compliance.py says dsdgen "does not finish below this scale"; the evidence is one run at SF 0.001 on darwin-arm64 killed after 60 s.

## Owner decision
Question: what #4401 left behind. Answer: "Recommended: raise ScaleFactorOutOfRangeError again, carrying the reason. Reword to what was observed: 'dsdgen did not finish at SF 0.001'." Source: owner's answer in the choice dialog, 2026-11-20.

## Change
Raise `ScaleFactorOutOfRangeError` for a below-floor TPC-DS scale through every entry point, carrying the reason. Reword the reason to the observation. The 0.01 floor is the owner's (2026-11-11: "Just raise the floor to 0.01 everywhere") and does not change.

## Decision gates
None. The floor value and the accepted range do not change.

## Verification rubric
Pass: a test fails on develop and passes after, showing tpcds and tpcds_obt at 0.001 raise `ScaleFactorOutOfRangeError` whose text names the floor and the observation; the existing floor tests pass; a changelog fragment describes the user-visible change.

## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
